title: Under The Radar
summary:
Japan's oil demand is staging a strong recovery
For much of the 1970s and 1980s, Japan was a shipowners' dream. It was a rapidly growing economy that almost completely relied on imports of raw materials to fuel its expanding industrial base. Before China took over in the early 2000s, Japan was the key driver of ton-mile demand in Asia.
